title: Front setback 15 m for plots above 10,000 sqm (MPD-2047 Table 7.3, row 6)

citations.clause: Table 7.3 (Minimum Setback Norms for Plotted Housing), row 6

notes: Read from the gazette text layer, p.178. Row: '6. Above 10,000 15 9 9 9' (Front, Rear, Side 1, Side 2). Same as UBBL p.154 (15 m, ubbl2016_compendium_2020.res_plotted.setback_front_m.above_10000). effective_from is the date of S.O. 4597(E), as for Table 7.2.
user_caveat: MPD-2047 Table 7.3 (a): if the permissible ground coverage is not achieved with these setbacks (under specific circumstances), the setbacks of the immediately preceding category may be permitted. Not modelled; check with the sanctioning authority.
